brief: 6 luxurious self-care rituals that cost less than a coffee.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.subtitle: SIX RITUALS THAT COST LESS THAN COFFEE

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: ICE GLOBE FACIAL
slots.body: Glide a chilled jade roller or ice globes across clean skin for two minutes. The cold instantly depuffs, tightens pores, and awakens your natural radiance without any expense.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: SCALP OIL MASSAGE
slots.body: Warm a few drops of coconut or argan oil between your palms. Massage into your scalp with slow, deliberate circles to release tension and encourage shine.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: DRY BODY BRUSHING
slots.body: Before your morning shower, sweep a natural bristle brush upward from your feet. This gentle exfoliation boosts circulation and leaves skin impossibly soft.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: HERBAL FACIAL STEAM
slots.body: Pour hot water over a handful of dried chamomile or lavender in a wide bowl. Drape a towel over your head and breathe deeply for five minutes of pure calm.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: EPSOM FOOT SOAK
slots.body: Fill a basin with warm water and a cup of Epsom salts. Add a few drops of essential oil while you unwind with a book.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: STEAM SHOWER RITUAL
slots.body: Place a few drops of eucalyptus oil on your shower floor before turning on the water. The rising steam creates a private spa sanctuary at home.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.headline: START TODAY
slots.body: Pick one ritual for your evening wind-down and notice how luxury feels within reach.
